verdict.rationale: For a JavaScript framework, the documented public API is the JS/component API itself. Vue claims an 'intuitive API and world-class documentation', the community explicitly discusses its redesigned public API, and a probe confirms a machine-readable llms.txt that AI agents can consume. The OpenAPI probe 404s are expected for a client-side library and do not count against it. Missing for 10: direct evidence of the API reference contents (only taglines are cited), and hands-on evidence of an agent driving Vue programmatically through that API.
